title: Aave raises Bitcoin and Ether borrowing limits across V3 and V4
description: Governance proposal 536 lifted maximum loan-to-value ratios for WBTC and cbBTC to 81% on V3 Ethereum Core and raised V4 Main Spoke collateral factors, based on a LlamaRisk calibration against two years of price data.

title: Coinbase Says Analytics Vendor Amplitude Exposed Customer Contact Data
description: Coinbase said a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude touched contact data for a small subset of customers, while the exchange reported no breach of its own systems and no impact to customer funds.

title: Coinbase Files for Brazil Crypto License Before Central Bank Deadline
description: Coinbase applied to Brazil's central bank on Wednesday under the country's new virtual asset service provider framework, joining Binance and Itau Unibanco in the Oct. 30 filing rush.

title: CFTC Sets Dec. 15 Roundtable on 24/7 Derivatives Trading
description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission will hold a public roundtable on Dec. 15 to examine whether derivatives markets can move to around-the-clock trading, building on its summer request for comment.

title: Solflare Says Staking Provider Key Incident Stopped Validator Rewards
description: Solflare told users on Oct. 27 that a security incident at its staking provider affected the keys held for its validator, pausing rewards for about 1.56 million SOL delegated while user principal stayed in their own stake accounts.
